scope.interaction: Add Action with keybinding, Save, project projection update, and keybindings.json persistence

productLoss: The Save action persists the new project script in the canonical project projection.
The matching script.fidelity-kb-action.run keybinding is absent from the isolated userdata/keybindings.json after Save.
The dialog closes despite completing only the first half of the Web authority save flow.
missingCoverageClosed: The verifier now checks the project projection and isolated keybindings file independently instead of inferring persistence from dialog dismissal.
The first baseline attempt used an overlong expected script id and was rejected as harness mismatch before product attribution.
intentionalPlatformDelta: Lynx accepts a textual canonical keybinding value because physical keyboard capture is not certified in DevTool; the value must still decode and persist through the same server contract as Web.
acceptedRenderingNoise: Visual anatomy and material remain accounted by project-action-dialog and are not duplicated in this mutation-only state.
